content:
TEMPTATION ||| Tilt my head closer, fingers brushing against his wrist ||| "You know, I could make this a lot more fun."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, loosening my grip on the blade ||| "I won't answer until I'm certain of my alignment."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, resolve softening ||| "I came here hoping you'd see me differently."  
REVERSAL ||| Firmly grasp the blade, raising it slightly ||| "I will decide what truth gets spoken here."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, the air thick with tension ||| *mm*
